text:
Nora (CS): Luminate going to run a customer-facing demo in ~2hrs. They reported spikes from eu-central and want a quick allowlist + burst so the demo is smooth.
Liu (AM): renewal meeting in 5 days; this demo outcome will heavily influence next steps. we should prioritize.
Sam (Network): can do. Need source CIDRs + target regions + desired QPS. Prefer temporary soft-quota with auto-expire.
Nora (CS): sending CIDRs: `54.213.120.0/24`, `203.119.37.128/26`. Add region `eu-central-1`. They asked for 200 rps burst for 2 hours (demo + buffer).
Ravi (Infra): +1 on auto-expire. i'll create CHG-4882 and attach a short runbook. Also recommend tagging this change as "demo-exempt" for audit.
Sam (Network): proposed rule I'll push:
```json
{
  "acct": "luminate",
  "allowlist": ["54.213.120.0/24","203.119.37.128/26"],
  "regions": ["eu-central-1"],
  "policy": {"mode":"soft_quota","requests_per_second":"200","duration_minutes":"120"},
  "auto_expire": "true",
  "notify_before_expire_minutes": "30"
}
```
Nora (CS): please also leave a note on the account: demo-only change, remove after window, ask customer for post-demo feedback on response times.
OpsBot: CHG-4882 created, scheduled start +10m, runbook https://intra/runbooks/CHG-4882 attached.
Sam (Network): applied to eu-central pool. quick smoke: p50 unchanged, p95 down from 820ms -> 560ms for sample demo traffic.
Liu (AM): great. i'll relay to customer and set a 30-min check-in after demo. also adding an enablement + feedback capture call next week to document any UX issues.
Ravi (Infra): change windows set to auto-expire at +125m to allow margin. audit note added.
Nora (CS): sending confirmation to Luminate: patch applied; will auto-revoke in 2h; we will notify 30m prior. offering a 15-min follow-up to collect feedback.
Liu (AM): renewal risk downgraded from "risky" -> "stabilized" pending demo performance.
OpsBot: CHG-4882 auto-expire executed at +127m; revocation successful. logs archived.
Sam (Network): revoke verified, default quotas restored. no post-change anomalies.
Nora (CS): closing thread. follow-up call scheduled; will add notes to renewal playbook and product feedback board for infra perf tuning. :white_check_mark:
